exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 216 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution), not just today's window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 216 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A handful of contacts carry more than one lead: tag (e.g. duplicate opportunities across pipelines for the same person), so tag counts don't sum exactly to 216 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the same 121-opportunity bulk-import batch (frozen since 2025-10-09/29 pipeline launch) and a handful of 200+ day Postponed records flagged in workflow_drift.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Continues the documented ~297 won / ~1,132 abandoned scale, growing steadily run over run.
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 49 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (64 total, lifetime). Retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds defined for this pipeline (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence).

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.note: Only 3 of 21 Meeting-Scheduled contacts had a verifiable appointment date this run (via today's active conversations: Sabrina Agard, Basil Felix Da Souza, Oz Aziz — all still actively engaged, no window issue). Same data-access limitation noted in the 2026-08-08 run (10/41 matched then); a dedicated per-contact appointment sweep is recommended before this becomes a reliable trend metric.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to today's active conversations and the mobile-quote-tagged contacts appearing in them (Mizanur Bhuiyan, Kevin, Rose Vill, Shaker Matti, Mellisa Fonte, Sowmya, and others); no violations found — all had outbound activity within the 5-day quote_followup_days window. A full account-wide sweep was not attempted this run (same scoping limitation as 08-08).

drift_findings_breakdown._comment: metrics.drift_findings is the sum of underlying affected records per category, not the count of report lines in workflow_drift (which aggregates large groups into single lines for readability).

reporting.resolved_since_last_report: 4 items flagged in the 2026-08-08 report as overdue for abandonment (Ben/Burlington, Bushrra Chaudhry, Luigi Marchesi, Abdul Khaliq) have since been resolved: Ben and Abdul Khaliq were closed out the same day as that report (08-08), Bushrra Chaudhry and Luigi Marchesi were abandoned together on 08-11. The auto-abandon workflow (or Albert manually) does eventually catch up.
reporting.platform_note_candidate: The tag 'abandoned-stale' appears on 3 open opportunities (Bash Saqr, Tina Tran, Anujan Kumaranathan) and is not in the documented GHL tag vocabulary in this agent's instructions or platforms/GHL.md — worth confirming with Albert whether it's an informal marker or an automation output, and adding it to the documented tag list if so.
reporting.ingest_gap_note: The last successful ghl-ingest run before this one was 2026-08-08 (a 6-day gap: 08-09 through 08-13 were not ingested). Per instructions this run used the standard 24h window (2026-08-13T12:46 UTC to 2026-08-14T12:46 UTC) rather than backfilling the gap; activity from 08-09 through 08-12 is not reflected in this file's items/metrics, though some of it surfaces indirectly in opportunity days_in_stage and the resolved_since_last_report note above.
